conformance.item: Step 1: read the phase rows in the plan and the triage note
Step 2: build only rows with an empty Completed cell, leave marked rows as they are
Step 3: write tests first and see them fail
Step 6: run only the test files the rows name
Step 7: check specs touched by changed source files
Step 8: write completed marks in one edit of the plan
Limits: no commit or push, change no file outside the rows
Hand over: end with ARTIFACT phase_note, one line
